summary: Företag 17 develops atomic layer etching technology for advanced semiconductor manufacturing. The company focuses on enabling smaller, more efficient and cost-effective semiconductor fabrication processes.
strategy_notes: Focused on commercializing proprietary atomic layer etching technology and scaling industrial adoption within advanced semiconductor production.
technology_notes: Develops atomic layer etching and pitch-splitting technologies intended to enable fabrication of advanced nanoscale semiconductor structures with improved efficiency.
risk_notes: Dependent on semiconductor industry adoption, successful process qualification, access to capital and competition from established semiconductor equipment and process technology providers.
